basic_details.job_title: RBI BMC Recruitment 2026 - Apply Offline for Banks Medical Consultant Posts

application_fee.details: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification.

age_limit.details: Please refer to the official notification for age limit details.

qualification.details: For Bank's Medical Consultant (BMC): Qualifications: MBBS degree of any recognized university in the Allopathic system of medicine recognized by the Medical Council of India. Experience: Minimum of two years' experience in practicing medicine in any hospital or clinic as a medical practitioner.

salary_details.details: ₹1400/- per hour for MBBS Doctors with up to 20 years of experience. ₹1800/- per hour for MBBS Doctors with more than 20 years of experience and MD Doctors. ₹1000/- per month treated as conveyance expenses.

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for RBI Bank's Medical Consultant (BMC) Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website:www.rbi.org.in/ .
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 04-10-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for RBI Bank's Medical Consultant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the RBI Bank's Medical Consultant (BMC) post is 04 October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in RBI Bank's Medical Consultant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Bank's Medical Consultant (BMC) post in the Reserve Bank of India recruitment.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for RBI Bank's Medical Consultant posts?
faq.answer: The application mode for the RBI Bank's Medical Consultant (BMC) posts is offline. Candidates need to send their applications to the specified address.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for Bank's Medical Consultant in RBI?
faq.answer: The salary for Bank's Medical Consultant ranges from ₹1400/- to ₹1800/- per hour, along with ₹1000/- per month for conveyance expenses.

faq.question: Q5. What are the eligibility criteria for Bank's Medical Consultant (BMC) post?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold an MBBS degree from a recognized university and have a minimum of two years of experience in practicing medicine.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for RBI BMC recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for the RBI Bank's Medical Consultant recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for RBI Bank's Medical Consultant?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Bank's Medical Consultant (BMC) post includes an Interview and Medical Tests.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the posting be for the Bank's Medical Consultant?
faq.answer: The posting location for the Bank's Medical Consultant will be in Bhubaneswar, Odisha.

faq.question: Q9. What is the official website for RBI recruitment?
faq.answer: Please refer to the official notification for the exact official website link for RBI recruitment details and application form download.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for Bank's Medical Consultant at RBI?
faq.answer: The Bank's Medical Consultant (BMC) position at RBI is on a contract basis with fixed hourly remuneration.
